body: See https://github.com/angular/angular/commit/16cc9b46aa166b19620979bac19d82d025a2ac0c, which explains why the two different `fakeAsync` calls in Jeremy's example share one zone and his workaround works. We do NOT currently do something like this for `async`, which explains my problem.

@juliemr yes, Tobias came across the issue of spawning brand new test zones for beforeEaches and its and fixed that for fakeAsync in 16cc9b4 - would you have time to send a PR for `async`? The solution should be similar to that in 16cc9b4

As far as fixing the original issue reported by @jelbourn. I'll discuss this with @mhevery. We have several options but none of the ones I currently know of I pretty.
I can't think of anything pretty either. I can do the fix for async, but unless we have a larger solution we'll still have failures if we try to do something like mix async and fakeAsync.
I think this looks like the best option for now!

issue.body:
R: @hansl @kara 

This PR includes:
- Temporarily move to head Angular until RC5 is released
- Introducing modules for each component and remove all `directives: [...]`
- Introducing an "all" module (`MaterialModule`)
- Bootstrapping via modules
- Update tests to use modules
- Workaround for https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/10503
- Bumps the version to alpha.6-3 (which I published under `@experimental` yesterday)
- Update to new `Provider` syntax
